name: vm_strap_q2_ref-strap6-COMMIT
purpose: Strap-identity quadrant master (coordinator decision per DEDUPE, 2026-10-15): bank / slice identity is a registered strap input (bid[2:0] / sid[1:0] pins, tied to die constants per instance, captured by pin flops), so the 8 banks of the quadrant use this ONE view; replaces the 8 literal-identity masters. Same data calendars and edges as identity2. Pins: identity2 r2 grant (actual tracks, PG-clear, explicit centres) + 5 strap pins on free N-face tracks beside the clock pair (proposal for H-DIE).

structural_change: strap6: pin -> AND2(valid) -> DFF write captures anchored at their pins (io_flop_at_pins OT_IOF_FOLLOW_AND=1). strap5 (q2/q3 strap4 TT -111.27/FF -1.66, 63 endpoints all launched at write-leaf valid replicas lv_rep -> ~350 ps buffered 32-load mask net -> AND -> write OR tree -> s1w_d / eg pin clones): each write source's payload is zeroed at its pin capture by its own valid pin (D-side AND at the face); payload pin flops feed the OR tree directly; only the 12 decoded sector bits stay masked by the leaf pin-valid flop; lv_rep removed; packet gets a separate write-payload capture. Same edges; random-garbage 40k-cycle equivalence vs strap4 0 mismatches, unmasked-capture mutant 37,583 mismatches.

reroute_reason.fix: io_flop_at_pins OT_IOF_FOLLOW_AND=1 (main b11bbff49): the valid-masked pin captures (pin -> AND2 -> DFF, 818 pins) are anchored at their pins; strap5 RTL unchanged. q3 slot binds this q2 master (sid strap = 3; Codex dedupe proof 260ad52e6), so q3 is not re-routed.
